name: Hirogaru Sora no Katasumi no
source:
Living in a rural town where only a dozen or so trains run daily, our protagonist leads a carefree life on his own, despite being occasionally pushed around by his eccentric father, who travels abroad for work.
Then, in a sudden phone call from his father, he learns that he has a new "stepsister." What's more, this out-of-nowhere stepsister will be arriving at the nearest station in about five minutes. Rushing to pick her up, unable to organize his thoughts, our protagonist meets a girl there.
"I'm Fuzuki Sora. Nice to meet you."
The girl has blonde hair that flows in the sunlight and captivatingly clear blue eyes, but she bows her head in a modest manner that doesn't suit her appearance.
Confused and awkward, the two head home.

In a corner of the vast sky, the story of a certain brother and sister begins...
translation:
主人公生活在一个每天只有十几班火车经过的乡下小镇。尽管偶尔会被因工作常年出国的古怪父亲捉弄，他仍独自过着悠闲生活。

某天，父亲突然打电话告诉他，自己多了一个“继妹”。更离谱的是，这位凭空出现的继妹大约五分钟后就要抵达最近的车站。主人公来不及整理思绪，匆忙赶去接她，在那里遇见一名女孩。

“我叫风月空，请多关照。”

女孩的金发在阳光下流动，蓝色双眸清澈迷人；与外表不相称的是，她以谦逊姿态低下了头。

两人困惑又尴尬地回到家。

在广阔天空的一角，某对兄妹的故事开始了……
